overview: A simple web-based task management app that lets a single user create, track, and manage tasks with a title, due date, and status. Tasks are persisted in a backend database and can be filtered by status and sorted by due date.
problem_statement: Individuals need a lightweight, distraction-free way to track tasks without the complexity of full-featured project management tools.

goals.item: Full CRUD on tasks with title, due date, and status fields
goals.reason: Core functionality — users must be able to create, view, update, and delete tasks

goals.item: Persist task data in a backend database
goals.reason: Tasks must survive page refreshes and browser sessions

goals.item: Filter tasks by status and sort by due date
goals.reason: Helps users focus on what matters and plan by deadline

non_goals.reason: Out of scope to keep the app minimal
Adds complexity not needed for this use case
Out of scope for this version

assumptions.assumption: The app will be used by a single person — no concurrent users or collaboration needed
A simple REST backend is sufficient — no real-time sync required

success_metrics: Core CRUD operations (create, update, delete tasks) work reliably
Tasks persist correctly across page refreshes and browser sessions
